raw:
Brendon Hartley's F1 starts that I could find were all for Toro Rosso (Scuderia Toro Rosso). The searches returned his results only from 2018 (German GP, US GP), and the 2017 searches turned up no Hartley entries, so I couldn't confirm his full start list from the tool. I found no evidence of him starting for any other team between 2000 and 2025, so the count is one.

ANSWER: 1
